root_motivation: Who: an agent whose user says 'the truth is this Google Sheet'. What: one host.sync.create call that registers a scheduled mirror of an external dataset into a host table. Why not today: host.table.create makes an empty table, append cannot update a row and host.trigger.set only calls a published tool, so the agent would own a sync loop forever.
user_persona: An agent that calls host.sync.create with a source kind and ref, gets a sync_id, and never writes a fetch loop; Operator Joe who reads docs/tools.md and llms.txt rendered from the SourceKind enum.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given SourceKind::ALL, When a test renders the tool schema, docs/tools.md, www/llms.txt and reads the puller dispatch arms, Then every kind appears in each exactly once and gen-docs --check exits 1 naming the file after any one copy is hand-edited.

Given a keyed free tenant, When host.sync.create {source: {kind: csv_url, ref}, table: orders} is called, Then the response carries sync_id, next_run_unix within 15 minutes, host.sync.list shows one row with status active, and the call took under 100 ms.

Given kind excel_online, a csv_url ref of http://10.0.0.1/x.csv, and google_sheet on a tenant with no Google connection, When each is created, Then the errors are args_invalid listing the five kinds, host_not_allowed, and connection_missing {provider: google}, and no syncs row exists.
Given a free tenant with 5 syncs, When a sixth is created, Then quota_syncs_max {limit: 5, used: 5} is returned and host.quickstart.limits.plan.syncs_max reads 5 from the same Plan field.

Given an active sync whose next_run_unix is in the past, When tick_once runs, Then one sync_runs receipt exists for it, next_run_unix moved to the next cron slot, and a second tick_once within the same slot writes no second receipt.
Given a sync, When host.sync.delete runs, Then host.sync.list is empty, the table still answers host.table.query, and a second host.sync.create with the same (kind, ref, table) returns a new sync_id.

scope: src/sync/mod.rs: SourceKind registry, host.sync.create/list/get/delete/run_now, the scheduler pass and the not_implemented run stub.
src/plans.rs: syncs_max (free 5, pro 50); src/triggers.rs: tick_once calls the sync pass; src/gendocs.rs renders the sync-sources table and llms.txt section.
non_goals: Fetching rows (the pull PRD); push or conflict handling; type inference beyond text columns; any new OAuth flow.

additional.no_pull: sync::run is a stub that writes a not_implemented receipt; the pull PRD replaces it.
additional.db: syncs and sync_runs live in the main database (migration 0130), not the per-tenant table files.

five_whys_trace.q: Why can an agent not mirror a Google Sheet into a host table today?
five_whys_trace.a: host.table.create makes an empty table and host.table.append cannot update a row.

five_whys_trace.q: Why not a trigger plus a published puller tool?
five_whys_trace.a: host.trigger.set only calls a published tool on a cron, so the agent owns the sync loop, token and diff forever.

five_whys_trace.q: Why does the host need a registry of source kinds?
five_whys_trace.a: the kind set appears in the tool schema, the docs, llms.txt and the puller dispatch, and four typed copies drift.

five_whys_trace.q: Why generate them from one enum?
five_whys_trace.a: prose at a boundary drifts; a derived contract cannot.

five_whys_trace.q: Why store and schedule before pulling?
five_whys_trace.a: the create surface, validation, quota and tick ownership ship independently of the pull PRD, which only fills sync_runs.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Where do syncs and sync_runs live?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: The main database next to the tenants table (migration 0130): the tick selects due rows across tenants in one query, and tenant deletion cascades.

ambiguities_resolved.question: What does mode push or two_way do at create?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: Accepted, stored with status pending_mode, and never run (the PRD's default).
